question: The average marks obtained in a subject by 60 students in a class is 82. The average marks of boys and girls in that subject are 75 and 85 respectively. The number of boys in the class is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the rule of Alligation on the average marks:

Ratio of Boys to Girls = (Girls Average − Overall Average) : (Overall Average − Boys Average)

Ratio of Boys to Girls = (85 − 82) : (82 − 75) = 3 : 7

Total parts = 3 + 7 = 10 parts

10 parts = 60 students ⇒ 1 part = 6 students

Number of boys = 3 parts × 6 = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18 boys.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total number of students = 60

Average marks of all students = 82

Average marks of boys = 75

Average marks of girls = 85
